title: Nvidia Stock Falls 4% as House China Committee Summons CEO Jensen Huang for Nov 18 Closed-Door Hearing
summary: The House Select Committee on China issued a subpoena to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, requiring him to testify at a closed-door hearing on November 18. The hearing is part of an ongoing congressional investigation into whether Nvidia's chips have facilitated China's military AI development. Nvidia shares fell approximately 4% on the news.
why: NVDA是核心持仓之一。data.json已收录11/8的初步调查新闻；本条新增事实为国会正式传唤（subpoena）黄仁勋11/18出席闭门听证+股价当日-4%。监管升级直接压制NVDA股价，可能触发sell put行权风险，并影响整体AI芯片板块隐含波动率。

title: PBOC Pledges Support for Stocks as China's Market Slide Defies Rescue Efforts
summary: The People's Bank of China pledged to expand its relending facility for share buybacks by US$45 billion and work with other regulators to stabilise markets, as China's equity market continues to slide despite multiple rounds of intervention. The CSI 300 has posted 12 consecutive weeks of declines, the worst run on record.
why: 港股/A股系统性下行，CSI 300创历史最长12周连跌。PBOC承诺扩大支持但市场仍在抵抗救市的信号对持仓港股多头构成压力（腾讯、阿里、美团、泡泡玛特、小米等），影响sell put执行时机和行权价评估。

title: China and Hong Kong Stocks Extend Rebound as State Funds Increase Buying and US Midterm Results Clear
summary: Chinese and Hong Kong equities extended their rebound as state-backed funds stepped up purchases and investors were reassured by the resolution of US midterm election results. The rebound follows the historic 12-week consecutive weekly decline for the CSI 300. Central Huijin Investment and other state funds increased ETF purchases.
why: 港股/A股实际反弹中（与同日3373166文章不同，本条记录的是实际涨幅发生）。美国中期选举结果明朗化消除了额外不确定性。对港股多头持仓构成估值修复机会，同时是重新评估sell put行权价的关键窗口。

title: 段永平浮亏18亿港元的意义
summary: 知名价值投资人段永平因重仓泡泡玛特(9992.HK)出现约18亿港元账面浮亏。文章分析了在当前港股低迷环境下，段永平坚持不卖的逻辑及对散户投资者的参考意义。
why: 泡泡玛特是核心持仓。段永平为知名价值投资人，其大额浮亏被媒体广泛关注，可能引发市场对泡泡玛特近期成长逻辑的再审视，同时影响股价短期情绪面与隐含波动率。data.json中已收录泡泡玛特POP BAKERY开店、回购、CLOT联名等项目，本条为新角度（投资人持仓动态）。
